content.short: Connecting everyone, everywhere. The first mobile network owned by the people and built on blockchain.
content.description: World Mobile was founded with a far-reaching goal: to connect everyone, everywhere while advocating for economic freedom and dignity. Simple. Traditional mobile networks won't connect remote places because it’s too expensive and hard to maintain. When you discover a giant problem it’s nearly impossible to ignore it: there are nearly 4 billion people unconnected globallythat’s half the world. It turns out there’s a reason.
content.meta: Find out about World Mobile (WMT) on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions.
